Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) Text Clause(s) Scope of Work events Arrangements for BPCL Para Games 2026-27 BPCL proposes to organise the inaugural Para Games at Kochi Housing Complex & RSC Kadavanthra Grou nd on 3–4 December 2026 for approx. 40 Para athletes. This scope defines the service provider’s responsi bilities for preparation, conduct and completion of the Games. To ensure smooth conduct of the event, it is required to arrange all necessary event setups and services, i ncluding BPCL branding (arches, standees, banners), food (breakfast, lunch/Dinner and Hi-tea) and transpo rt arrangements during the event. backdrop, podiums, bouquets, and floral decorations are to be arranged for the opening and closing ceremonies. Umpires Technical Officials & boys for wheelchair assistance playe rs to be arranged for the tournament days, and we also plan to host a dinner and a cultural entertainment program by regional artists. For the opening and closing ceremonies, we require a stage backdrop and dec orations. Additional requirements include prizes, kit, giveaways and mementos, a photographer for all eve nt days, stage costs and event stationery.
